_comment: DESIGN.md v2 §6. Frozen at tag freeze-design; the report script reads k, ranking, CI settings and verdict rules only from this file and fails if its sha256 differs from configs/frozen_hashes.json.

EN-pred.method: hierarchical stability elastic net (DESIGN §4.1); = MD-pure; built without reading observed effects

universe: identical (g, d) universe U for all arms: g eligible (§2), d in 𝒟_g with >= 5 carriers among non-NaN D lines; CN features deduplicated per (g, locus group) to the best-ranked member before top-k

P1_primary.question: Q2
P1_primary.statistic: replication rate among the arm's top-k candidates
P1_primary.candidate_pool: (g, d) in U that are R-evaluable (>= 3 carriers and >= 3 non-carriers with expected non-NaN effect) and have R power >= 0.5
P1_primary.power: from EB-shrunk D effect (design_params replication_s6.shrinkage), identical for all arms, computed before freeze-catalogue
P1_primary.replicated: same sign as D AND one-sided p < 0.05 in R (confounder model, same covariate drops, CR2 by PatientID)

ci.method: paired bootstrap over R lines grouped by PatientID; lists fixed; tests refitted

secondary_variants: top-k over all U (non-evaluable counted as not replicated)
gene-matched: at most 2 features per gene
list-level: sign concordance (binomial vs 0.5), Deming slope beta_R on beta_D, observed/expected replications

XLIB_co_endpoint.question: Q2 (secondary co-endpoint)
XLIB_co_endpoint.discovery: D lines with Avana-only screens; all four arms re-run (same params, own lambda CV on the discovery lines)
XLIB_co_endpoint.replication: D lines with no Avana screen (KY-only, Humagne-only); Avana+KY and other mixed lines excluded from both
XLIB_co_endpoint.statistic_and_ci: as P1 (power from discovery-set shrunk effects; bootstrap over replication-set patients)
XLIB_co_endpoint.caveat: OOF predictions of discovery lines come from Part 1 fold models trained on replication-set effects: pred arms are not independent here. EN-pred vs EN-obs on XLIB is descriptive; EN-obs vs S1-obs is a valid co-endpoint. Tier B adds EN-pred-clean from an M1 refit cross-validated within the discovery lines only.

P2_primary_clinical.question: Q4a
P2_primary_clinical.statistic: recall of testable S/W CGT tests (partitions sensitivity + bypass-resistance; ko_class concordant, concordant-family, concordant-KO/combination-required)
P2_primary_clinical.hit: a (g in target set T, d = test feature) in the arm's top-k, any sign
P2_primary_clinical.direction_accuracy: separate: hits with pre-registered sign / all hits
P2_primary_clinical.paired_test: exact McNemar per pair of arms on test-level hit outcomes

sets.gate_disjoint: tests not in configs/positive_controls.csv; headline whenever results/gate_iterations.csv has more than one row

everything_else: secondary; REPORT.md labels it as such
wording_rules: MSI->WRN and MTAP->PRMT5/MAT2A recovery is 'recovered, also used as a pipeline gate', never 'independent validation'
